name: AstroVerse Formal Validation Rules & Model Specifications
disclaimer: All weights represent pre-specified classical Jyotish heuristics and ablation model weights for epistemic clarity. Predictions are rule-based hypotheses, not deterministic certainty.

MODEL_A.name: Full Parashari Baseline (D1 + D9 + Vimshottari + Shadbala)
MODEL_A.description: Standard traditional model incorporating Rasi (D1), Navamsha (D9), Vimshottari Dasha-Bukthi, and 6-fold Shadbala.

MODEL_B.name: Ablation Model B: D1 Rasi-Only (No Vargas / No D9)
MODEL_B.description: Evaluates predictive behavior when restricted strictly to Rasi chart placements and aspects.

MODEL_C.name: Ablation Model C: Dasha-Only Chronological Timing
MODEL_C.description: Evaluates predictive power when relying exclusively on operating Vimshottari Mahadasha and Antardasha lords.

MODEL_D.name: Ablation Model D: KP Cuspal Sub-Lord Model
MODEL_D.description: Krishnamurti Padhdhati cuspal sub-lord significators and Placidus/KP house cusps.

MODEL_E.name: Ablation Model E: Jaimini Chara Dasha & Karakas
MODEL_E.description: Jaimini system utilizing 7/8 Chara Karakas (Atmakaraka, Darakaraka, etc.) and sign-based Chara Dasha.

MODEL_F.name: Ablation Model F: Ashtakavarga Samudaya & Bhinna Points
MODEL_F.description: Evaluates planetary and transit strength purely based on Ashtakavarga bindu allocations (SAV / BAV).

MODEL_G.name: Ablation Model G: Synthesized Multi-System Ensemble
MODEL_G.description: Multi-tier ensemble weighting combining Parashari, Jaimini, KP sub-lords, and Ashtakavarga.

rules.name: 7th Lord in 11th House Relationship Fulfilment
rules.rationale: 7th lord in 11th house signifies gain through marriage, social fulfillment, and supportive partnership.

rules.name: Venus-Jupiter Benefic Conjunction
rules.rationale: Conjunction or trine of natural benefics Venus and Jupiter expands mutual virtue and relationship stability.

rules.name: Saturnian Influence on 7th House / Lord
rules.rationale: Saturn aspecting or residing in 7th introduces deliberateness, mature partner, or marriage timing post-28.

rules.name: 10th Lord in 1st House Independent Authority
rules.rationale: 10th lord in Lagna establishes strong personal initiative, leadership identity, and professional prominence.

rules.name: Sun in 10th House Directional Strength (Digbala)
rules.rationale: Sun achieves maximum directional strength (Digbala) in the 10th house, indicating executive aptitude.

rules.name: 2nd Lord and 11th Lord Sambandha (Dhana Yoga)
rules.rationale: Mutual aspect, conjunction, or exchange between wealth (2nd) and gains (11th) lords forms potent Dhana Yoga.

rules.name: 6th Lord in 8th House Vipareeta Raja Yoga
rules.rationale: Dusthana lord in another dusthana creates Vipareeta resilience, overcoming acute health crises through latent endurance.
